== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Red]] District is one of the nine colored sectors that make up the [[City of Light]]. It is characterized by an urban layout where everything is organized into precise squares, a feature that assists in monitoring multiple streets simultaneously. The entrance to this district is marked by an exceptionally wide door, designed specifically to allow the passage of wagons. While it is one of several distinct areas within the city, it is noted for having empty streets when traveling from the [[Violet District]].}}
